A '''Hutt''' was living during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5341 BBY]], he became the father of [[Zirchros]], who went on to become a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. The Hutt had formed a large collection of artifacts from an extinct [[Unidentified civilization (Zirchros)|civilization]], which his son came into the possession of sometime before the year [[3641 BBY]].

==Biography==
A Hutt who was living in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] became the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] named Zirchros<ref name="TOR" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5341 BBY]].<ref name="Birthdate">In {{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Memoirs of a Crimelord}} it says that Zirchros was 1,700 years old. Since the game takes place around the year 3641 BBY, Zirchros must have been born around the year 5,341 BBY.</ref> At some point in [[Gender/Legends|his]] life, the Hutt had obtained a large collection of cultural artifacts from a [[Unidentified civilization (Zirchros)|civilization]] that had been extinct for some time by [[3641 BBY]]. By this year, the Hutt's son had become a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and had obtained the collection of artifacts.<ref name="TOR" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
However, at that time, Zirchros was [[Death/Legends|dying]] and he told an individual about his father's collection. The individual found the Hutt's artifacts and brought them to an ally.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zirchros's father was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]]. He was mentioned in the archaeology crew skill mission entitled "Memoirs of a Crimelord" which was available for players of both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and Republic factions. In a crew skill mission, the player would send one of their companions to complete the mission, but due to the mission being available to all classes it was unknown who met with the Hutt's son. As a reward for the mission, the player received some lost artifact fragments.<ref name="TOR" />
